Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 24
, Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer presented an incorrect conclusion without properly verifying the C-suite composition at the IPO. It wrongly claimed Eliran Glazer was the only member not in the C-suite during the IPO and incorrectly stated that Shiran Nawi and Daniel Lereya were already in the C-suite then. This error stemmed from failing to accurately compare the IPO-era leadership with the current C-suite and ignoring that multiple members (Shiran Nawi, Yoni Osherov, Daniel Lereya) were not in C-suite roles at the IPO.
